claims.statement: The pinned workflow note labels GitHub agentic workflows as changeable public preview, not stable or verified currently available functionality.
The third-party CLI fragment enumerates Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Google Gemini CLI; this isolated list neither certifies interoperability nor authorizes installing or running any of them.

The mobile-credit note excludes additional AI-credit purchase when a Copilot subscription is or previously was obtained through the mobile application on iOS or Android. The historical subscription condition matters; switching purchase channel must not be assumed to erase it.
The alternative-suggestion fragment says a given input may produce multiple options, from which the user can select or decline all; neither multiple results nor their accuracy is guaranteed.

The Claude-agent model fragment lists two Liquid variables. Inspection of their pinned definitions resolves them to Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Sonnet 4.6; this list does not prove target entitlement, complete model coverage or present-day availability.

The pinned discount fragment conditions a 10-percent model-cost reduction on a paid Copilot plan and use of auto model selection in Chat, CLI, the Copilot app or the cloud agent. It is not a universal subscription discount, a live price verification or permission to incur charges.
